plain: Keep everything we tell you about the project secret.
legal: The Recipient shall keep all information disclosed in connection with the Project strictly confidential.

plain: Don't share our customer list with anyone.
legal: The Recipient shall not disclose the Company's customer list to any third party.

plain: You can tell your lawyers and accountants, but they have to keep it secret too.
legal: The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to its legal and financial advisers, provided that such advisers are bound by obligations of confidentiality no less protective than those set forth herein.

plain: This doesn't cover stuff that's already public.
legal: The obligations herein shall not apply to information that is or becomes publicly available other than through a breach of this Agreement.

plain: It also doesn't cover things you already knew before we told you.
legal: Confidential Information shall not include information that was lawfully known to the Recipient prior to its disclosure hereunder.

plain: If a court orders you to share it, you can, but tell us first.
legal: The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information where required by a court order, provided that the Recipient gives the Disclosing Party prompt prior written notice of such requirement.

plain: You must keep this secret for 5 years after the agreement ends.
legal: The obligations of confidentiality shall continue for a period of five (5) years following the termination of this Agreement.

plain: Trade secrets have to stay secret forever.
legal: The obligation of confidentiality in respect of trade secrets shall continue indefinitely.

plain: Only use our information to evaluate the deal.
legal: The Recipient shall use the Confidential Information solely for the purpose of evaluating the proposed transaction.

plain: Only employees who need to know can see the documents.
legal: Access to the documents shall be restricted to those employees of the Recipient who have a need to know for the Permitted Purpose.

plain: Tell us right away if there's a leak.
legal: The Recipient shall notify the Disclosing Party immediately upon becoming aware of any unauthorized disclosure.

plain: Don't make copies unless you really need to.
legal: The Recipient shall not make copies of the Confidential Information except to the extent strictly necessary for the Permitted Purpose.

plain: You're responsible if your staff leak anything.
legal: The Recipient shall be liable for any breach of this Agreement committed by its employees.

plain: Giving us the information doesn't give you any ownership of it.
legal: The disclosure of Confidential Information shall not confer upon the Recipient any right, title or interest therein.

plain: We don't promise the information is accurate.
legal: The Disclosing Party makes no representation or warranty as to the accuracy or completeness of the Confidential Information.

plain: Don't try to reverse engineer any samples we give you.
legal: The Recipient shall not reverse engineer, decompile or disassemble any samples provided by the Disclosing Party.

plain: Store the files securely, at least as carefully as you store your own secrets.
legal: The Recipient shall store the files securely, exercising no less than the degree of care it applies to its own confidential information.

plain: Neither of us can say publicly that we're talking about a deal.
legal: Neither Party shall make any public statement concerning the existence of discussions between the Parties.

plain: Money alone might not fix a leak, so we can also go to court to stop it.
legal: The Parties acknowledge that damages alone may not be an adequate remedy for a breach hereof, and the Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief.

plain: Marked documents are confidential, and so is anything said in meetings if we say so within 10 days.
legal: Documents marked as confidential shall constitute Confidential Information, as shall oral disclosures identified as confidential in writing within ten (10) days thereof.

plain: Don't contact our suppliers without our permission.
legal: The Recipient shall not contact any supplier of the Company without the Company's prior written consent.

plain: You can't hire our employees for 12 months after this ends.
legal: For a period of twelve (12) months following termination, the Recipient shall not solicit or employ any employee of the Company.

plain: Information you develop on your own isn't covered.
legal: This Agreement shall not apply to information independently developed by the Recipient without use of the Confidential Information.

plain: Please return or destroy everything when we ask.
legal: Upon the written request of the Disclosing Party, the Recipient shall promptly return or destroy all Confidential Information.

plain: You can keep one copy for legal records, but it stays confidential.
legal: The Recipient may retain one (1) archival copy for legal compliance purposes, which shall remain subject to the obligations of confidentiality.

plain: Don't put our data on personal devices.
legal: The Recipient shall not store any data of the Company on personal devices.

plain: Salary details must not be discussed outside the HR team.
legal: Salary information shall not be disclosed to any person outside the Human Resources department.

plain: The source code is confidential even if it isn't marked.
legal: The Source Code shall constitute Confidential Information whether or not it is marked as such.

plain: Only share passwords through the approved password manager.
legal: Passwords shall be shared exclusively by means of the approved password management system.

plain: You may share the report with your board of directors.
legal: The Recipient may disclose the Report to the members of its board of directors.

plain: Patient records may never be emailed outside the clinic.
legal: Patient records shall not under any circumstances be transmitted by email outside the Clinic.

plain: Breaking this agreement could cost you $50,000.
legal: Any breach of this Agreement may render the breaching Party liable for damages of up to $50,000.

plain: Visitors must sign an NDA before entering the lab.
legal: All visitors shall execute a non-disclosure agreement prior to entering the Laboratory.

plain: Don't take photos in the factory.
legal: Photography is prohibited within the Factory premises.

plain: The recipient must use encryption when sending our files.
legal: The Recipient shall encrypt all files of the Disclosing Party prior to transmission.

plain: These rules apply to our affiliates' information too.
legal: The obligations herein shall apply equally to Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party's affiliates.

plain: You can share it with contractors only if they've signed a similar agreement.
legal: The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to its contractors only if such contractors have entered into a confidentiality agreement on substantially similar terms.

plain: Pricing in this proposal is confidential until March 1.
legal: The pricing set forth in this Proposal shall remain confidential until March 1.

plain: The confidentiality period starts from the date of first disclosure.
legal: The confidentiality period shall commence on the date of the first disclosure of Confidential Information.

plain: We won't use your feedback to identify you publicly.
legal: The Company shall not use the User's feedback in any manner that publicly identifies the User.

plain: Anything you learn about our security systems is secret.
legal: Any information concerning the Company's security systems obtained by the Contractor shall be treated as Confidential Information.

plain: Don't discuss the case on social media.
legal: The Parties shall refrain from discussing the matter on any social media platform.

plain: Interview questions shouldn't be shared with other candidates.
legal: Candidates shall not disclose interview questions to any other candidate.

plain: You have to tell us if you lose a laptop with our data on it within 24 hours.
legal: The Contractor shall notify the Company within twenty-four (24) hours of the loss of any laptop containing Company data.

plain: Both sides will keep the terms of this settlement private.
legal: The Parties shall keep the terms of this Settlement strictly confidential.

plain: Either party can reveal the settlement to tax authorities if required.
legal: Either Party may disclose the terms of this Settlement to tax authorities where required by applicable law.

plain: Exam papers stay locked up until the exam begins.
legal: Examination papers shall be kept under lock until the commencement of the examination.

plain: The secrecy obligation doesn't stop you from reporting a crime.
legal: Nothing herein shall prevent any Party from reporting a suspected criminal offense to the competent authorities.

plain: Team members can't talk to the press about the merger.
legal: No member of the Team shall communicate with the media regarding the merger.

plain: The board minutes are confidential and only directors may read them.
legal: The minutes of board meetings shall be confidential and accessible solely to the directors.
